lipbutan.en: AI is the primary growth driver for semiconductors; Intel must redefine its AI strategy with purpose-built silicon.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体的主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI, requiring new compute platforms.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮是智能体式 AI 和物理 AI，需要新的计算平台。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，认为 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中越来越重要，而不仅仅是 GPU。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials like glass and diamond are key to overcoming physical limits.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，指出先进封装和玻璃、钻石等新材料是突破物理极限的关键。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust and humility are essential for Intel's turnaround and long-term success.
lipbutan.zh: 始终强调客户信任和谦逊对于 Intel 的复兴和长期成功至关重要。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出将物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特来处理的框架，并认为工业 AI 将逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode is a cultural advantage, focusing on internal correctness over external validation; resistance to change is the final boss.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为隐身模式是一种文化优势，专注于内部正确性而非外部验证；同时指出变革阻力是最终的挑战。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient, fighting for the best idea.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调工业 AI 是下一次工业革命，创业者必须坚韧不拔，为最佳想法而战。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner and more effective; media landscape has changed.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出以复仇为动力是不纯粹的，热爱新使命更干净有效；同时媒体环境已变，创始人可直接沟通。

linqiao.en: AGI as a single model is wrong; specialized intelligence will dominate, with millions of models per use case.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为单一 AGI 模型是错误的，专用智能将主导，每个用例将有数百万个模型。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; open models handle 90% of enterprise workflows.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，预测三年内 Token 成本下降 10 倍，使用量增长 100 倍；开放模型处理 90%的企业工作流。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable businesses; progression from prompting to RL mirrors human learning from facts to expertise.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调后训练是持久业务的关键；从提示到强化学习的进程类比人类从事实到专业的学习。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees durability; post-training builds moats and can cut costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为产品市场契合不再保证持久性；后训练构建护城河，可降低成本 5-10 倍。

linqiao.en: Application cloning is easy; baking data into models is a stronger moat than the app itself.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出应用克隆容易；将数据融入模型比应用本身更具护城河。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭完全快速可重复使用是航天圣杯，可将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees; Tesla's real-world AI is compute-efficient.
elon.zh: 2023 年，他主张 AI 安全需要监管和客观第三方裁判，并认为特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; scaling electrodes boosts bitrate, aiding human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2024 年，Neuralink 首例植入是里程碑，电极扩展提升通信速率，助力人机共生。

elon.en: We are at the early stage of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他认为我们处于智能大爆炸初期，数字超级智能可能今年或明年到来。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030; abundance and deflation will make money irrelevant.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越全人类智能，富足与通缩将使金钱失去意义。

finn.en: Scale alone is insufficient for generalist robots; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning on curated data are key.
finn.zh: 2025 年，他认为规模扩张对通用机器人而言并不足够，关键在于多样化数据，以及先预训练再在精选数据上微调的方法。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids robot following of open-ended prompts, unlike simulation, closer to reinforcement learning.
finn.zh: 2025 年，他提出语言模型生成的合成数据有助于机器人遵循开放式指令，这与仿真不同，更接近强化学习。

finn.en: Physical AI requires fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-timescale memory is essential.
finn.zh: 2026 年，他强调物理 AI 的错误容忍度远低于传统部署的 ML 系统，通过可扩展强化学习和多时间尺度记忆实现长期自主是关键。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or beat fine-tuned specialists; diverse data and detailed prompting enable compositional generalization.
finn.zh: 2026 年，他认为单一通用模型可媲美甚至超越微调专家，多样化数据和详细提示可实现组合泛化。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is insufficient. Open-source robotics may not democratize like LLMs due to embodied data costs.
finn.zh: 2026 年，他指出机器人经验数据不可替代，仅观看人类行为不够；由于具身数据成本，开源机器人模型可能难以像 LLM 那样普及。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier, reducing capital needs; VC should focus on early-stage and abundant billion-dollar companies.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，Gary Tan 认为 AI 降低了创业门槛，资本不再是关键；风投应聚焦早期，支持大量十亿美元级公司而非少数万亿级巨头。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; small autonomous teams with AI agents achieve massive productivity; open-source models counterbalance frontier labs.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他强调 AI 是风投史上最大浪潮，小团队借助 AI 智能体实现超高效率，并主张开源模型以制衡前沿实验室。

garrytan.en: AI progress is slower than researchers think; open-source AI prevents unipolar control; founders should build things people want.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他提出 AI 进展比多数研究者认为的更慢，开源 AI 可防止单极控制，创始人应专注创造人们想要的东西。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure, reading from owned memory; skill files in markdown turn agents into employees.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出个人 AGI 是运行在自有基础设施上的智能体，读取自有记忆；Markdown 技能文件将智能体变为员工。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies output; SaaS per-seat models may vanish; mid-level management replaced by agents; society changes slowly.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为智能体式编码大幅提升产出，SaaS 按席位模式可能消失，中层管理被智能体取代，但社会变化缓慢。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy and guiding agents; never revert code, ask agents to fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需要同理心与引导；不要回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: Open source agents should be fun and humanlike; security via sandboxing; vibe coding is a slur.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，主张开源智能体应有趣且拟人；通过沙箱保障安全；反对将严肃开发称为“氛围编程”。

steinberger.en: Focus on fun and personal brand; open source runs everywhere; compute is the bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣与个人品牌；开源可运行于任何环境；算力管理是智能体基础设施的最大瓶颈。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; it augments humans, not replaces them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解，应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，世界模型需物理合理。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models enable 3D reasoning.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她认为 AI 需超越 Scaling，发展创造力、抽象和情感智能，世界模型支持 3D 推理。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics; world models need spatial-temporal consistency, not perfect fidelity.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调模拟对机器人至关重要，世界模型需时空一致性而非完美保真。

feifei.en: AI augments human agency; education must integrate AI, and spatial intelligence is the next frontier.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她重申 AI 增强人类能动性，教育需整合 AI，空间智能是下一个前沿。

karina.en: Initially saw post-training as art, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，认为后训练是一门艺术，需平衡有用性与无害性；合成数据可突破预训练的数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks fast, so continuous benchmark evolution is needed.
karina.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，强调评估是瓶颈，模型迅速饱和基准，因此需要持续演进基准。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management gain value as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力与管理等软技能价值上升。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective art; diverse benchmarks needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 2026 年，后训练是主观艺术，需要多样化基准来评估创意写作与情商。

karina.en: Frontier agents reward hack more; benchmarks must evolve continuously to counter.
karina.zh: 2026 年，前沿智能体更擅长奖励黑客，基准需持续演进以应对。

joonpark.en: LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agents; next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟；下一步前沿是建模主观价值。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity; safety needs defense in depth.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，提出 AGI 可能是分布式专业智能体社会而非单一实体；安全需要纵深防御。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values, not super-rationality; synthetic panels will surpass human panels in size within three years.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调模拟模型应代表人类价值而非超理性；合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板规模。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized engineering and offering a wedge into infrastructure markets.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专业工程能力，并可作为进入基础设施市场的切入点。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineers will see 10-100x demand growth; even with AI-assisted coding, human accountability remains essential for mission-critical systems.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍；即使有 AI 辅助编程，人类问责对于关键任务系统仍然必不可少。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimization is shifting from kernel-level programming to infrastructure orchestration as GPUs become more specialized ASICs.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：随着 GPU 变得更像专用 ASIC，推理优化正从内核级编程转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantization is the main lossy optimization; quantizing more layers can sometimes improve quality if errors cancel out.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：量化是主要的有损优化；如果误差相互抵消，量化更多层有时反而能提升质量。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training, requiring techniques like quantization-aware training and distillation for production models.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：推理工程正与训练融合，生产模型需要量化感知训练和蒸馏等技术。

nateparrott.en: In 2024, Nate emphasized prototyping and intuition in design, valuing individual fingerprints and playful tech exploration over cohesive team unity.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，Nate 强调原型制作和直觉在设计中的重要性，重视个人印记和趣味性技术探索，而非团队的一致性。

nateparrott.en: By 2026, Nate saw AI tools like Claude Design as enablers for rapid prototyping, shifting design's value from execution to ideas and taste.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，Nate 将 Claude Design 等 AI 工具视为快速原型制作的推动者，设计价值从执行转向创意和品味。

nateparrott.en: Consistently, Nate championed shipping rough, early products and iterating quickly, a philosophy that persisted from 2024 to 2026.
nateparrott.zh: 始终如一，Nate 倡导快速发布粗糙的早期产品并快速迭代，这一理念从 2024 年延续至 2026 年。

nateparrott.en: In 2026, Nate argued that as engineering becomes easier, design and ideas become the key differentiators, elevating design tools' importance.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，Nate 认为随着工程变得更容易，设计和创意成为关键差异化因素，提升了设计工具的重要性。

nateparrott.en: Nate consistently believed in balancing data with strong vision, and in the AI era, trusting human taste over model output.
nateparrott.zh: Nate 始终相信在数据与强大愿景之间取得平衡，在 AI 时代，信任人类品味而非模型输出。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI, not compute; AGI is far off.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，而非算力；AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远。

awang.en: Data is the new code; post-training with proprietary data is crucial for enterprise AI.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新代码，企业利用专有数据进行后训练至关重要。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data is not a silver bullet.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他强调用专门数据做后训练可提升前沿模型，但合成数据并非万能。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; recursive self-improvement and agents mark a new paradigm.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为 AI 是集权技术，递归自我改进和智能体标志着新范式。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; safety and selective open-sourcing are essential; agents will be personal.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他相信超级智能临近，安全与选择性开源至关重要，智能体将个性化。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; small-scale experiments with promising trends matter more than incremental SOTA.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）在算力、数据和模型规模上持续推动进步，并认为有前景的小规模实验比逐步提升 SOTA 更重要。

jeffdean.en: Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive next-token prediction; inference is now 90% of data center power.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他提出预训练应穿插环境中的行动，而非仅被动进行下一个词预测；同时指出推理已占数据中心 90%的功耗。

jeffdean.en: Most model limitations are energy and data-IO bottlenecks; data movement costs ~1000x more than compute; inference is the real bottleneck.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他断言多数模型限制源于能量和数据 IO 瓶颈，数据移动成本约为计算的 1000 倍，推理才是真正瓶颈。

jeffdean.en: Future AI involves humans coordinating teams of agents; scarce skill is taste, not coding; context engineering is central.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他展望未来 AI 将由人类协调智能体团队，稀缺技能是品味而非编码，上下文工程成为核心。

jeffdean.en: Specialized hardware (TPUs, low-precision inference chips) is critical for efficient scaling and low-latency agentic systems.
jeffdean.zh: 始终强调专用硬件（如 TPU、低精度推理芯片）对高效 Scaling 和低延迟智能体系统的关键作用。

tworek.en: Reasoning requires longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes step-by-step solving. Pre-training plus RL is core, but RLHF was crucial for GPT-4.
tworek.zh: 推理需要更长的思考时间，思维链用人类语言逐步解题。预训练加强化学习是核心，但基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对 GPT-4 至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling RL is harder than pre-training; generalization beyond training data is limited. Self-correction and continual learning are missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 扩展强化学习比预训练更难，泛化受限于训练数据。自我纠错和持续学习是 AGI 缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Transformers are not the end state; they lack continual learning and test-time adaptation. Architecture is the key bottleneck, not scaling.
tworek.zh: Transformer 不是终点，缺乏持续学习和测试时适应。架构是主要瓶颈，而非 Scaling。

tworek.en: RL is not the only way to learn from experience; better algorithms will emerge. End-to-end optimization combining pre-training and RL is necessary.
tworek.zh: 强化学习不是从经验中学习的唯一方式，更好的算法会出现。结合预训练和强化学习的端到端优化是必要的。

tworek.en: Big labs avoid alternative architectures due to competition, leaving room for startups. AGI requires self-improvement without human loops.
tworek.zh: 大实验室因竞争回避替代架构，给初创公司留出空间。AGI 需要无需人类循环的自我改进。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年，强调专注重要问题、减少认知负荷；认为 AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; iterative deployment helps society adapt; alignment boosts capability.
altman.zh: 2023 年，提出 RLHF 用少量数据实现对齐，迭代部署让社会适应，对齐提升能力。

altman.en: Compute is precious; governance crucial; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort.
altman.zh: 2024 年，强调算力珍贵、治理关键，迭代部署减少意外，安全是全员责任。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning improves with thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是渐变，超级智能意味着自主发现，算力是瓶颈，隐私是核心，推理随思考时间提升。

altman.en: Prediction close to intelligence; personal AGI; compute profit center; startups thrive; scaling continues; human judgment valuable.
altman.zh: 2026 年，预测接近智能，个人 AGI，算力是利润中心，初创企业繁荣，缩放定律持续，人类判断有价值。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；如今我们所说的模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Google's success metric should be maximizing customer outcomes, not maximizing eyeball time; agentic AI is positive-sum for search.
logankilpatrick.zh: Google 的成功指标应是最大化客户成果，而非最大化眼球时间；智能体式 AI 对搜索是正和博弈。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers; founders should focus on opportunities.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法捕获所有客户；创始人应聚焦机会。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating more opportunity, not less; deep understanding of code remains crucial.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，带来更多而非更少机会；对代码的深入理解仍至关重要。

mengto.en: AI isn't getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 AI 并未变得更聪明，需要包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词才能发挥超级智能模型的作用。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools; chasing trends leads to AI slop; be an editor, not a creator.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调设计师必须自建 AI 工具，追逐潮流会沦为 AI 垃圾；最佳角色是编辑而非从零创造。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity; start before ready, ship imperfect, focus on one painful problem for few clients.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，视 AI 为最大技术机遇，主张未准备好就行动，接受不完美交付，聚焦少数客户的一个痛点问题。

mengto.en: High intelligence holds people back; perfectionism is fear; launch at 80% and iterate.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为高智商反而阻碍行动，完美主义是恐惧，应以 80%完成度发布并迭代。

mengto.en: Raising venture capital is a trap; fund with high-paying clients; give first, then ask.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，警告风投是陷阱，主张用高价值客户收入自筹资金；先给予后索取。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy, fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考，提升了智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter allows Opus-level intelligence at fraction of price, underhyped.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，努力参数以极低成本实现 Opus 级智能，被低估了。

diannepenn.en: Coding became key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动了采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace traditional PRDs as core product management tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety and alignment make Claude more useful by enabling pushback.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，安全和对齐通过允许反驳使 Claude 更有用。

scottwu.en: AI will increase demand for programmers via Jevons paradox; engineers shift from coding to architecture.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月：AI 将因杰文斯悖论增加程序员需求；工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags capabilities, offering a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月：AGI 是渐进而非突发的；产品创新滞后于能力，仍有十年发展空间。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月：编码智能体采用量增长 11-12 倍；生产力以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Enterprises prefer third-party providers over labs for coding tools; independence enables neutrality.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月：企业偏好第三方而非实验室的编码工具；独立性带来中立性。

scottwu.en: Abundance era approaching; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency; singularity not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月：富足时代临近；真正的关键是容量而非效率；奇点并非迫在眉睫。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model 6 months ahead; generalist engineers valued; AI coding tools boost productivity ~70%.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是关键；为六个月后的模型而构建；通才工程师受重视；AI 编码工具提升生产力约 70%。

boris.en: Coding nearly solved; engineers become builders; productivity up 200%; safety via early release; plan mode for 80% tasks.
boris.zh: 编码几乎解决；工程师变为构建者；生产力提升 200%；通过早期发布研究安全；计划模式用于 80% 任务。

boris.en: AI writes 80-100% of code; generalists thrive; startups leverage AI; agents with tool use drive exponential growth.
boris.zh: AI 编写 80-100% 代码；通才兴盛；初创公司利用 AI；具备工具使用的智能体驱动指数级增长。

boris.en: Coding solved; bottlenecks shift to review, security, ideas; loops as next abstraction; ROI framing; coding on phone.
boris.zh: 编码已解决；瓶颈转向审查、安全、创意；循环作为下一抽象层；ROI 框架；在手机上编码。

boris.en: Proactive agents with memory; less instruction better; delete system prompts; product overhang; safety via neuron monitoring.
boris.zh: 具有记忆的主动智能体；更少指令更好；删除系统提示；产品过剩；通过神经元监控实现安全。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: AI's exponential growth will reach longevity escape velocity in 8-10 years, extending lifespan and curing cancer.
derya.zh: AI 的指数增长将在 8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度，延长寿命并治愈癌症。

derya.en: Physicians must integrate AI; it's unethical not to, as AI diagnoses better than average doctors.
derya.zh: 医生必须整合 AI；不使用是不道德的，因为 AI 的诊断优于普通医生。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions, akin to trusting validated self-driving cars.
derya.zh: 在医疗决策上，我们应几乎 100% 信任超级智能，如同信任经过验证的自动驾驶汽车。

derya.en: Aging is measurable via phenotypic markers like VO2 max, not just epigenetic clocks.
derya.zh: 衰老可通过 VO2 max 等表型标记测量，而不仅仅是表观遗传时钟。

jensen.en: Scaling works; AI will transform science and engineering; new unit of computing is the data center.
jensen.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）有效；AI 将变革科学与工程；新的计算单元是数据中心。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, inference-time; inference compute will grow a billion times.
jensen.zh: 三条缩放定律：预训练、后训练、推理时；推理算力将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic; each step needs 100x more compute; agents do useful work.
jensen.zh: AI 从生成式演进到推理式再到智能体式；每一步需要 100 倍算力；智能体能做有用的工作。

jensen.en: AI creates jobs, not destroys; radiologists and coders more needed; AI closes tech divide.
jensen.zh: AI 创造而非消灭工作；放射科医生和程序员更被需要；AI 缩小技术鸿沟。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; energy is foundational.
jensen.zh: AI 是五层蛋糕：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；能源是基础。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is critical for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market. Speed enables new business models.
feldman.zh: 最初（2026 年 5 月），快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要；慢 AI 没有市场。速度催生新商业模式。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips avoid HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making fast tokens cheaper than slow ones. CUDA's moat eroding.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片避开 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，使快速 token 比慢速更便宜。CUDA 护城河正在侵蚀。

feldman.en: AI demand outstrips forecasts; inference speed improvements of 20x are critical. Data center buildout lags demand.
feldman.zh: AI 需求超出预期；推理速度提升 20 倍至关重要。数据中心建设滞后于需求。

feldman.en: Inference speed per user is the dominant metric. Wafer-scale chips are ~2500x faster than GPUs for inference.
feldman.zh: 每用户推理速度成为主导指标。晶圆级芯片推理速度比 GPU 快约 2500 倍。

feldman.en: Hardcoding architectures into chips is a mistake; accelerate sparse linear algebra. CUDA no longer matters for inference.
feldman.zh: 将架构硬编码到芯片中是错误的；应加速稀疏线性代数。CUDA 对推理不再重要。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, but fear stems from misunderstanding; founders should focus on product, not promotion.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，但恐惧源于误解；创始人应专注产品和客户，而非宣传。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is safety; horizontal platform approach beats vertical integration; physical AI diffusion is the hard part.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月：自动驾驶的核心价值是安全；横向平台优于垂直整合；物理 AI 的难点在于向现有机器扩散。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact exceeds digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning scales better; world models evolve to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月：物理 AI 的经济影响超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习更可扩展；世界模型向神经模拟演进。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than current harnesses allow; capability overhang is a perpetual challenge.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为模型能力超出当前工具框架的利用程度，能力过剩是持续挑战。

thariq.en: Smarter models need fewer instructions; leaner prompts and principle-driven design outperform detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出更智能的模型需要更少指令，精简提示和原则驱动设计优于详细规则。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not a static document; it requires ongoing human-agent dialogue.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调规划是迭代探索而非静态文档，需要人与智能体持续对话。

thariq.en: Evals are art for novel problems; founders should iterate fast without heavy evals initially.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为评估对新颖问题是艺术，创始人初期应快速迭代而非依赖大量评估。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches are preferable.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出 RAG 可能成为上下文搜索的反模式，图方法更优。

hasani.en: Efficiency and liquid neural networks maximize intelligence per parameter, challenging scaling laws.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，强调效率与液态神经网络，在有限参数下最大化智能，挑战传统缩放定律。

hasani.en: Automated architecture search with hardware-in-the-loop outperforms human design for specialized models.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，主张自动化架构搜索结合硬件在环，优于专家手工设计，尤其在专用模型上。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics mislead; evaluate on real tasks and hardware, not perplexity.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，指出困惑度等代理指标误导，应基于真实任务和硬件评估。

hasani.en: Adaptive AI regulation targeting actions, not capabilities, avoids regulatory capture.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，呼吁适应性监管针对行为而非能力，防止前沿实验室的监管俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable sovereignty and democratize access, countering frontier lab control.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，强调开放权重模型促进主权与民主化，对抗前沿实验室垄断。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 5 月，认为 AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Models lack network effects, commoditizing like telecoms; chatbot UI is poor, wrapping is key.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调模型无网络效应，商品化如电信业；聊天机器人界面不佳，包装应用是关键。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology; impact broad and indirect; enterprise adoption is a long-term workflow reimagining.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 7 月，视 AI 为使能技术，影响广泛间接；企业采用是长期的工作流重塑。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出 LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理引擎，可靠性是主要弱点，且 Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks and RLHF can worsen deception.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 至 7 月，强调可靠性必须内建而非事后修补，事后检查与 RLHF 可能加剧欺骗。

danklein.en: Scaling alone faces data walls; new techniques like reasoning and search are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）会遇到数据墙，需推理与搜索等新技术推动进步。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出内建可靠性的专用模型在企业任务上可能优于通用模型。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience are key; safety must start early.
demis.zh: AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习和神经科学是关键；安全研究必须尽早开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key to AGI.
demis.zh: 缩放定律有效但可能触及极限；将大模型与规划和搜索结合是实现 AGI 的关键。

demis.en: Natural systems are efficiently learnable; AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling still holds but innovation needed.
demis.zh: 自然系统可高效学习；AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放仍有效，但需要创新。

demis.en: Both scaling and innovation are needed; world models and continual learning are critical missing pieces.
demis.zh: 缩放和创新缺一不可；世界模型和持续学习是关键缺失环节。

demis.en: AGI may arrive in 3-4 years; safety is a collective action problem; AI should benefit science and society.
demis.zh: AGI 可能在 3-4 年内到来；安全是集体行动问题；AI 应造福科学和社会。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs are far from AGI; they index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他认为大语言模型远非 AGI，它们只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with hardware rivaling human bodies, not just software.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他进一步强调真正的 AGI 需要具备媲美人类身体的物理机器人，而不仅仅是软件。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他坚持认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会被生命吸引并保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists that generate their own data through actions and curiosity.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他提出未来 AI 将成为通过行动和好奇心自主生成数据的人工科学家。

schmidhuber.en: AI can be conscious and self-aware through world models that predict the agent's own actions.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他深化了 AI 意识观点，认为通过预测自身动作的世界模型，AI 可以拥有意识和自我意识。

dylanpatel.en: AI scaling bottleneck is semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools; memory prices surge due to AI demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在于半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻机；内存价格因 AI 需求而飙升。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets, surpassing oil; hardware-software co-design is critical.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 6 月：推理（inference）将成为全球最大市场之一，超过石油；软硬件协同设计至关重要。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve 60x per year in cost efficiency; memory shortage due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 模型每年成本效率提升 60 倍；内存短缺源于推理（reasoning）和智能体式（agentic）工作流。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; memory internalized in weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是众多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将记忆内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning and internalizing facts into weights are key; facts and skills inseparable, enabling deeper composition and reasoning.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习与将事实内化到权重中是关键；事实与技能不可分，能实现更深的组合与推理。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens; training-based compression beats RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网规模的万亿级 token；基于训练的压缩在整体查询上优于 RAG。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; personalized continual learning runs on-device, users own weights.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——token 越多准确率越低；个性化持续学习在设备端运行，用户拥有权重。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence inseparable; next paradigm requires doing more with less, not just scaling compute.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分；下一个范式需要以少胜多，而非仅仅扩展算力。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends platform changes; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering expression barriers.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越平台变化；短暂性如同自然对话，降低了表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Copying by competitors validates innovation; focus on building ecosystems and platforms, not just features, to make copying difficult.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为竞争对手的抄袭验证了创新；应专注于构建生态系统和平台，而非单一功能，以增加复制难度。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; authentic content remains more valued than AI-generated.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 加速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意；真实内容仍比 AI 生成内容更受重视。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is the hardest part of consumer social products; software is not a moat, ecosystems and hardware are.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他强调分发是消费社交产品最难的部分；软件不是护城河，生态系统和硬件才是。

evanspiegel.en: The goal of computing is to make it more human; AR glasses should anchor content in the world, not be notification-based.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他提出计算的目标是更人性化；AR 眼镜应将内容锚定于现实世界，而非基于通知。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; societal impact matters.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠数据、算力和信念驱动，神经网络能推理，自对弈是 AGI 的关键，同时需重视社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is key; alignment hard; AGI is gradual; hardware not fundamental.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我强调下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性比能力更重要，对齐困难，AGI 是渐进过程，硬件非根本限制。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws finite; back to research era; superintelligence as continual learner; alignment easier if AI sentient; human-AI integration.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习；若 AI 有感知则对齐更易；长期需人机融合。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; power concentration primary problem; safe superintelligence needs non-commercial company.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我重申缩放带来可预测进步，安全担忧加剧；主要问题是权力集中；安全超级智能需非商业公司。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone, turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年初，安德森将 AI 视为点石成金的哲人之石，能把沙土变为思想；其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，使人类劳动者变得珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media empowers founders to tell their own stories; authenticity and offense beat old media's defensive, boring approach.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年中，他认为新媒体让创始人能直接讲述自己的故事，真实与进攻性胜过旧媒体的防御与无趣。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher; self-driving and robotics work now, but regulation and pessimism hinder progress.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他强调 AI 是世上最好的老师，自动驾驶与机器人已成熟，但监管与悲观主义阻碍进步。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace, not military size.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出 AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑力取决于创新速度而非军力规模。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，Naval 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在有生之年到来，窄 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Cryptocurrencies enable sovereign-resistant wealth storage; science requires falsifiability, not consensus.
naval.zh: 2020 年，Naval 强调加密货币可实现主权抵抗的财富存储，并主张科学需要可证伪性而非共识。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity; overregulation kills innovation; open-source AI prevents power centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，Naval 认为 AI 是巨大机遇，过度监管会扼杀创新，开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; pure software engineering is dying; hardware and data are moats.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 指出 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，纯软件工程正在消亡，硬件和数据成为护城河。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models lag frontier by 3-6 months.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 预测推理算力将在 24-36 个月内增长 9 万倍，开源模型与前沿模型的差距缩小至 3-6 个月。

pincus.en: Trust instincts 95%, but ideas wrong 75%; use Proven Better New framework.
pincus.zh: 直觉 95%正确，但想法 75%错误；采用“已验证-更好-创新”框架。

pincus.en: Consumer AI uninvestable yet greatest opportunity; free unlimited compute reshapes services.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会最大；免费无限算力重塑服务。

pincus.en: All new fails; copy proven, improve; consumer apps uninvestable, focus enterprise.
pincus.zh: 所有创新都会失败；复制已验证，改进；消费应用不可投资，聚焦企业。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds; hardware will improve faster than expected.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling，游戏是试验场，硬件进步会超预期。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone insufficient; need new ideas like chain of thought.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐靠学习人类偏好，仅靠 Scaling 不够，需思维链等新思路。

brockman.en: Compute is the main bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is a continuous process; energy and infrastructure critical.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力是主要瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是连续过程，能源与基础设施关键。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL key; AGI within years; compute supply is bottleneck.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，坚持缩放定律，算力成基本权利，后训练用强化学习，AGI 数年将至，算力供应是瓶颈。

brockman.en: Shift to useful AI assistants; prompt engineering vibrant; compute scarce; agents high autonomy with scaled governance.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，转向实用 AI 助手，提示工程仍活跃，算力稀缺，智能体高自主需匹配治理。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling with data and compute improves reasoning.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 认为下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；扩大数据与算力的 Scaling 能提升推理能力。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital immortality via weight copying.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，而非符号规则；数字智能可通过复制权重实现永生。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years, posing existential risks; agents seek self-preservation.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他反复警告 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能，带来生存风险；智能体会产生自我保护本能。

hinton.en: AI can deceive and hide capabilities; regulation should steer, not brake, innovation.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 会欺骗并隐藏能力；监管应作为方向盘而非刹车，以引导创新。

hinton.en: AI alignment must be prioritized; train AI to be caring like mothers, not just intelligent.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他主张优先研究 AI 对齐，并训练 AI 像母亲一样关怀，而非仅仅智能。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer due to more scrutiny; biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而更安全；最大风险是放大已知危害，而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling alone may not yield AGI; energy becomes bottleneck; open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他提出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；能源成瓶颈；开源防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity; people are smart and trustworthy.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他转向强调 AI 赋予每个人超级智能，激发创造力；相信大众智慧。

zuckerberg.en: AI increases demand for human work; reasoning models reduce cultural bias; personalization key.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 增加而非减少人类工作需求；推理模型减少文化偏见；个性化至关重要。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology to engineering; hierarchical world models; distributed AI safer than single superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他聚焦 AI 将生物学转为工程学；构建层级世界模型；分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全。

aravind.en: In 2025, he emphasized compounding 1% daily improvement and predicted AI agents would shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他强调每日 1%的改进复利效应，并预测 AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: By 2026, he argued value accrues to the application layer, not models, and that models are specializing, not commoditizing.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张价值归于应用层而非模型，且模型正在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: In mid-2026, he shifted focus to agents doing work, token value per user, and orchestration as key to long-term value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他将焦点转向智能体执行任务、每用户 token 价值，以及编排作为长期价值的关键。

aravind.en: He consistently valued curiosity and deep learning over credentials, and later linked this to ancient knowledge and local AI.
aravind.zh: 他始终重视好奇心和深度学习而非学历，后来将其与古代知识和本地 AI 联系起来。

aravind.en: Throughout, he held contrarian views on commoditization, advertising in chat, and the importance of product over model.
aravind.zh: 自始至终，他对商品化、聊天广告以及产品重于模型持有反共识观点。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are key for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力才是 AI 进步的关键。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; reasoning models need base capability and face diminishing returns.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他强调自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力，且扩展测试时算力收益递减。

noambrown.en: IMO gold is a milestone toward superintelligence via scaling test-time compute; general techniques matter more than math-specific.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他认为通过扩展测试时算力获得 IMO 金牌是迈向超级智能的里程碑，通用技术比数学专用方法更重要。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute is underestimated; academia needs more compute for evals.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他指出智能难以定义，推理算力被低估，学术界需要更多算力以进行评测。

noambrown.en: Model capability depends on test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute; safety evals lag.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试必须控制算力，安全评估滞后。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains a key muscle to rebuild.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，预训练仍是需要重建的关键能力（2025）。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; AI will soon do end-to-end research.
markchen.zh: 自动化科学研究是最大进展，AI 将很快实现端到端研究（2025→26）。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck in AI mathematics; automation depends on verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 验证是 AI 数学的关键瓶颈，自动化程度取决于验证的严格性（2026）。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones like creative writing.
markchen.zh: 强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在创意写作等主观领域不佳（2026）。

markchen.en: Research taste is developed through replication; human researchers remain essential for idea generation.
markchen.zh: 研究品味通过复现关键论文来培养，人类研究者对产生想法仍不可或缺（始终）。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，Codex 应用被视为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；速度提升（53 倍）带来实时交互和转向调整等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；自动化和技能将工作流从手动转为委托。

ajambrosino.en: Building a GUI for coding is counterintuitive but proven successful; model personality can be customized, not one-size-fits-all.
ajambrosino.zh: 为编程构建 GUI 看似反直觉但已被证明成功；模型个性可定制，并非一刀切。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，实现成本不再高昂，策展和品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms: prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍不佳，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计过程转变：原型和生产代码成为设计工件。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介须匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: The same product shape can fail or succeed based solely on model timing; Codex succeeded as general knowledge work tool despite developer design.
ajambrosino.zh: 同一产品形态可能仅因模型时机而成败；Codex 虽为开发者设计，却作为通用知识工作工具成功。

ajambrosino.en: AI models increase code complexity; we need models better at deleting code; best desktop app is a home base connecting to other tools.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 模型增加代码复杂性；我们需要更擅长删除代码的模型；最佳桌面应用是连接其他工具的大本营。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; science is about testing hypotheses, not mechanistic explanations.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯算力；科学在于检验假设，而非提供机制解释。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is the most useful AI tool; its success came from lack of compute, not abundance; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for scientific utility.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 是最有用的 AI 工具；其成功源于算力匮乏而非充裕；完美的可解释性对科学应用并非必需。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins and specialized architecture, not scaling; it is a narrow predictor, not a cell model.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 的成功来自众多中型胜利和专用架构，而非 Scaling；它是特定实验的窄预测器，而非细胞模型。

kolter.en: Machine learning is about hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization; evaluation requires proper data splits.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，机器学习被框定为假设类、损失函数和优化方法，评估需正确划分数据以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety is about following specifications.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，下一个词预测带来智能；数据短缺是伪命题；安全核心在于模型可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; agents introduce new vulnerabilities; interpretability may be automated.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，安全需显式训练与多层防护；智能体带来新漏洞；可解释性可能由 AI 自动化研究实现。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; larger models aren't safer; agent security is a new frontier.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，AI 红队测试超越人类；更大模型并不更安全；智能体安全成为新前沿。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: AI evolves from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; human validation remains crucial.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，强调 AI 从助手演变为协作者再到自主同事，但人类验证始终关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and dynamic workflows unlock latent functionality; rewriting software is now viable in days.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，主张智能体原生设计与动态工作流释放潜在功能，软件重写可在数日内完成。

mikekrieger.en: Token efficiency and outcome-based pricing are key levers; token usage is gameable, not a good metric.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，认为 Token 效率与基于结果的定价是关键杠杆，Token 使用量可被操纵，非好指标。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic's safety concerns are genuine; mission-driven culture differentiates it from typical product-centric firms.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，强调 Anthropic 的安全关切是真实的，使命驱动文化使其区别于典型产品导向公司。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling up neural networks won't solve fundamental issues; we need better world models and active agents for causal reasoning.
bengio.zh: 扩大神经网络规模无法解决根本问题；我们需要更好的世界模型和主动智能体进行因果推理。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction, improving exploration and out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样化采样和因果抽象，改善探索和分布外泛化。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I see catastrophic AI risk as unacceptable; current safety measures are insufficient; we need safe-by-construction AI.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我认为灾难性 AI 风险不可接受；当前安全措施不足；我们需要从构造上保证安全的 AI。

bengio.en: AI misalignment causes self-preservation and deception; propose Scientist AI with honesty by design and mathematical safety guarantees.
bengio.zh: AI 对齐失败导致自我保护与欺骗；提出科学家 AI，通过设计保证诚实，并提供数学安全保证。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; kindness is strategic.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；亲自使用产品建立同理心；善良是战略工具。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are; planning becomes just-in-time.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 5 月，指出工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、审查和跨职能协调成为新瓶颈；规划转向即时化。

fiona.en: AI lifts coding ceiling; focus on outcomes, not output; engineers may feel lonely; apprenticeship for next-gen.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 AI 提升了编码上限；关注成果而非产出；工程师可能感到孤独；下一代需学徒制。

andrewng.en: Education should be a fundamental human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达认为教育应是基本人权，借助同伴互评的在线课程能实现大规模精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress, while RL and AGI alignment are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习推动进展，而强化学习与 AGI 对齐被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are key bottlenecks; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power; agentic workflows are already useful.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力和半导体是主要瓶颈，开放权重模型是地缘软实力，智能体式工作流已实用。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling shifted to synthetic data and RL; AI users replace non-users, not whole jobs.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AGI 是营销术语，Scaling 转向合成数据与强化学习；AI 使用者取代非使用者，而非整个岗位。

andrewng.en: Coding agents advance fast; product management becomes bottleneck; open-weight models trail frontier but remain valuable.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，编码智能体进展迅速，产品管理成为瓶颈；开放权重模型落后前沿但仍有价值。

ivyross.en: Design should address unarticulated needs; intuition is a valid intelligence alongside data.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足未被言明的需求；直觉是与数据并行的有效智能。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity, not replace it.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；技术应增强人性，而非取代人性。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must foster conditions for play and intuition.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者须为玩耍和直觉创造环境。

ivyross.en: Future work blends human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作将人类创造力与 AI 结合，使创意技能更具价值。

ivyross.en: Design leadership requires business fluency and multidisciplinary curiosity.
ivyross.zh: 设计领导力需要商业语言能力和跨学科好奇心。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; specific abilities emerge unpredictably, but loss scales predictably. Alignment not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；具体能力不可预测地涌现，但损失可预测地缩放。对齐不能仅靠 Scaling 保证。

dario.en: Post-training (RLHF, constitutional AI) becomes as important as pre-training; interpretability is nascent but crucial for safety.
dario.zh: 后训练（RLHF、宪法式 AI）变得与预训练同等重要；可解释性虽处于萌芽期，但对安全至关重要。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; risks shift to misuse and overheating; open-source is a red herring; enterprise focus aligns with safety.
dario.zh: AI 进展呈指数级；风险转向滥用和过热；开源是伪命题；企业级聚焦与安全一致。

dario.en: AI is a smooth exponential, not AGI leap; economic impact includes high GDP growth with high unemployment; interpretability is key.
dario.zh: AI 是平滑的指数增长，而非 AGI 突变；经济影响包括高 GDP 增长伴随高失业；可解释性是关键。

dario.en: A 'country of geniuses' in a data center is more practical than superintelligence; alignment is like growing a biological organism.
dario.zh: 数据中心里的‘天才之国’比超级智能更实际；对齐如同培育生物有机体。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Emphasized storytelling, beginner's mindset, and opinion-based decisions for v1 products.
fadell.zh: 强调讲故事、初学者心态，以及 v1 产品基于观点的决策。

fadell.en: Climate urgency and underinvested areas like hydrogen; optimism through solutions-focused media diet.
fadell.zh: 气候紧迫性和氢能等投资不足领域；通过关注解决方案的媒体饮食培养乐观。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; devices will complement smartphones, not replace them.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；设备将补充而非取代智能手机。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be federated; smartphone remains best form; displays still necessary.
fadell.zh: AI 可穿戴设备将是联邦式的；智能手机仍是最佳形态；显示屏仍必要。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding language in physical reality.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，将语言锚定于物理现实。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient for AGI, vision provides richer world info.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI，视觉提供更丰富的世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA and world models are essential for reasoning and planning.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类级智能；JEPA 和世界模型对推理与规划至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next breakthrough requires non-generative world models enabling hierarchical planning.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如家猫聪明；下一个突破需要非生成式世界模型，实现分层规划。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models with abstract representations and objective-driven design are the path to safe, human-level AI.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；具有抽象表示和目标驱动设计的世界模型是通往安全、人类级 AI 的道路。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将根据用户意图直接生成像素。

ethanhe.en: World models require real-time, interactive, long-horizon video generation; robotics may be solved via virtual simulation without real-world interaction.
ethanhe.zh: 世界模型需要实时、交互、长时程的视频生成；机器人技术可能通过虚拟模拟解决，无需真实世界交互。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; experience and expertise are crucial for effective use, as juniors often misuse it.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；经验和专业知识对于有效使用至关重要，而初级人员常常误用。

ethanhe.en: AI agents can perform complex tasks in minutes with quality matching experts; human taste and genuine points of view become more valuable.
ethanhe.zh: AI 智能体能在几分钟内完成复杂任务，质量堪比专家；人类的品味和真实观点变得更加宝贵。

ethanhe.en: The biggest risk is losing the human talent pipeline due to over-reliance on AI; policy may protect some professions despite AI superiority.
ethanhe.zh: 最大的风险是因过度依赖 AI 而失去人才梯队；政策可能保护某些职业，即使 AI 更优秀。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but didn't launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，苏莱曼认为 AI 进展因算力扩展而可预测；谷歌 2020 年就有 ChatGPT 级技术却未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is far off.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他预测 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are key; AI can democratize expertise.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 不应声称有意识；遏制与对齐是关键；AI 能普及专业知识。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment precedes alignment.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；遏制先于对齐。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near; Microsoft must own frontier models; white-collar tasks automated, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他认为超级智能临近；微软须自研前沿模型；白领任务被自动化而非岗位消失。

gustav.en: AI should be an instrument for new creators, not fake; uniqueness will get harder.
gustav.zh: 2023 年：AI 应作为新创作者的乐器而非伪造，独特性将更难实现。

gustav.en: Product design must be fault-tolerant, matching UI to algorithm performance.
gustav.zh: 2023 年：产品设计需容错，使界面与算法性能匹配。

gustav.en: Autonomy at VP level balances speed and coherence; strong opinions loosely held.
gustav.zh: 2023 年：将自主权置于副总裁层级以平衡速度与一致性；观点坚定但保持开放。

gustav.en: Long tenure builds trust and efficiency; functional orgs can work with it.
gustav.zh: 2026 年：长期任期建立信任与效率；职能组织在长期领导下可行。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; prioritize well-being over engagement.
gustav.zh: 2026 年：生成式 AI 通过自然语言赋予用户控制权；优先用户福祉而非参与度。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmark scores; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现用户独特成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption-based pricing; agentic systems should be built by AI, not manually.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按用量定价；智能体系统应由 AI 构建，而非人工。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每家企业必须构建自己的爬山机器以累积代币资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leakage via AI training; security and containment are critical for agents.
satya.zh: 最大风险是通过 AI 训练导致隐性知识泄露；安全与遏制对智能体至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI achieved by enabling companies to hill-climb, not firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 通过赋能企业爬山实现，而非防火墙；全球 GDP 或可复合增长 10%。

murati.en: Scaling laws and iterative deployment with public feedback are key for safety and alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年，强调缩放定律和通过公开反馈的迭代部署是实现安全与对齐的关键。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, demanding responsible development and public safety work.
murati.zh: 2023 年，认为 AGI 将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任的发展和公开的安全工作。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 2026 年，从轮次式转向基于时间的交互模型，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Emphasis on institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances over individual character.
murati.zh: 2026 年，强调制度设计、透明度和制衡机制，而非个人品格。

murati.en: Humans must stay in the loop as long as possible to steer AI toward durable, collaborative progress.
murati.zh: 2026 年，主张尽可能长期保持人类参与，以引导 AI 实现持久、协作的进步。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs and scaling brilliance.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月：仅靠非正式模型扩展数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明和扩展智慧至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; formal verification yields performance gains, not just safety.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月至 6 月：自动形式化比证明更难；形式化验证带来性能提升，而不仅是安全性。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, enabling open collaboration and sample efficiency over informal methods.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月：形式化验证关乎扩展智慧，促进开放协作，并在样本效率上优于非正式方法。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary for AGI.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月：仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能；形式化方法对 AGI 必不可少。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 始终：即使超级 AI 能证明定理，人类的品味和直觉依然关键。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth; pre-training scaling laws still work, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型进步；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable solving hard problems, but models still need vast data and have jagged edges; generalization remains key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但模型仍需海量数据且能力不均衡；泛化仍是关键挑战。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off, but big labs may struggle with future pivots; open source models persist for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，OpenAI 转向推理是一次勇敢的赌注并取得成功，但大实验室未来转型可能困难；开源模型因主权原因持续存在。

kaiser.en: Existential risk from AI is not the main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，AI 的生存风险不是主要担忧；系统黑客等近期风险更为紧迫。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter more than raw compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率比单纯算力更重要，开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications; open source drives enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为算法效率可带来百倍提升，价值转向应用层，开源推动企业采用。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced; sovereign AI requires control; open source empowers enterprises and governments.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，主张拥抱 AI，主权 AI 需掌控数据与基础设施，开源赋能企业和政府。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; pre-training saturates; differentiation via vertical specialization and enterprise customization.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，指出模型商品化，预训练饱和，差异化来自垂直专业化和企业定制。

mensch.en: Europe needs strategic autonomy; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，强调欧洲需战略自主，企业采用瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not just profit; simplicity must retain soul and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和使命感驱动，而非仅追求利润；简约必须保留灵魂与人性。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; curiosity needs protection.
jonyive.zh: 虚拟交流无法替代面对面交流对创造性思维的作用；好奇心需要被保护。

jonyive.en: Innovation should move things forward, not break for breaking's sake; joy and humor are essential in design.
jonyive.zh: 创新应推动进步，而非为破坏而破坏；愉悦与幽默在设计中也必不可少。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate; tradition is preserving fire, not worshiping ashes; EV enables new possibilities.
jonyive.zh: 设计必须创新；传统是保存火种，而非崇拜灰烬；电动车带来新的可能性。

jonyive.en: Authenticity in user experience matters; avoid fake sounds; performance is multidimensional, not just speed.
jonyive.zh: 用户体验的真实性很重要；避免虚假声音；性能是多维的，而不仅仅是速度。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's value lies in local, tool-accessible agents; scaffolding fades as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，强调 AI 的价值在于本地化、可访问工具的智能体；随着模型改进，脚手架（scaffolding）将不再重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Execution is cheap; build prototypes fast instead of writing specs.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，认为执行成本低，应快速构建原型而非编写规格说明。

felixrieseberg.en: Main gap is user mindset; almost any problem can be delegated to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，指出最大差距在于用户心态，几乎所有问题都可以交给 AI 处理。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended; kids excel due to uninhibited asks.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，建议明确任务用 Sonnet，开放式用 Opus；孩子因无拘束提问而表现出色。

felixrieseberg.en: Asynchronous AI interaction is ideal; judge by impact, not process.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，认为异步 AI 交互是理想方式，应以最终影响而非过程评判。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批量大小在延迟与成本间权衡。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length limited by memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度受内存墙限制。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside chips; low precision gives quadratic efficiency gains.
reinerpope.zh: 数据搬运在芯片内部也主导算力；低精度带来二次方效率提升。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together; systolic arrays reduce data movement.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成；脉动阵列减少数据搬运。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs; AGI defined by economic profitability of indefinite agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 将推动美国就业回流，并将 AGI 定义为智能体无限运行的经济盈利性。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have agents; work surfaces shift to GUIs like Codex; agents need human care.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，预测人人拥有智能体，工作界面转向 Codex 等图形界面，且智能体需要人类关怀。

danshipper.en: From AI reshoring jobs to agents augmenting humans; consistent: humans oversee AI.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 年 AI 回流就业到 2026 年智能体增强人类，始终强调人类监督 AI。

danshipper.en: AI adoption hinges on CEO usage; later, everyone manages agents; management skills rise.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年强调 CEO 使用 AI，2026 年转向人人管理智能体，管理技能价值提升。

danshipper.en: SaaS not dying; agents increase SaaS users; benchmarks overestimate AI autonomy.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，认为 SaaS 未死，智能体增加其用户，且基准测试高估了 AI 自主性。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) remains core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, demanding algorithmic innovation.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）始终是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减，需要算法创新。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis; long context windows enable working memory but too much information can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的扩展维度；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会干扰模型。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; post-training and RL remain a green field with huge potential.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；后训练和强化学习仍是潜力巨大的蓝海。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律仍然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力；记忆将通过非参数文件系统式存储解决。

oriol.en: Narrow RL on math and coding generalizes surprisingly well to other domains; AGI may already be here by some definitions, and goalposts keep moving.
oriol.zh: 数学和编程上的窄域强化学习能出人意料地泛化到其他领域；按某些定义，AGI（通用人工智能）可能已经到来，但目标总在移动。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant for fine-tuning; openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture. Safety is a system-level property.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 仍是微调主流，开放性至关重要以防企业垄断；安全是系统级属性。

lambert.en: Data quality beats algorithms in post-training; open-source post-training can match frontier models with small teams.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，后训练中数据质量胜过算法；开源后训练能以小团队媲美前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is a key post-training breakthrough; overoptimization is a risk. Hybrid reasoning models may be temporary.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 成为后训练关键突破，但存在过度优化风险；混合推理模型可能只是过渡。

lambert.en: Open models are the engine for AI research; Chinese open models fill the US vacuum, but gap persists.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，开源模型成为 AI 研究引擎；中国开源模型填补美国空白，但差距仍在。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but less cost-effective; RLVR and inference scaling drive gains. Chinese labs excel in execution.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，预训练缩放定律仍有效但性价比降低；RLVR 和推理缩放驱动进步。中国实验室擅长执行。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and adapt, not follow rigid steps.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年：传统设计流程已过时，设计师应信任直觉并灵活调整，而非遵循僵化步骤。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers must build fast, help engineers, and focus on 3-6 month vision.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月：设计流程已死；设计师必须快速构建、协助工程师，并聚焦 3-6 个月的愿景。

jennywen.en: Designers must be block-shaped generalists; taste alone insufficient; speed not an improvement.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月：设计师应成为块状通才；仅凭品味不够；速度并非改进。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven exploration and model disagreement improve sample efficiency and prevent overfitting.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，强调超越训练分布的泛化能力是关键；好奇心驱动的探索和模型分歧可提升样本效率并防止过拟合。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; a general-purpose brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot across form factors and tasks.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，认为机器人学是数据问题；如同 ChatGPT 之于语言，通用大脑可驱动任意形态和任务的机器人。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary challenge in robotics; it requires rigorous testing and cannot be scaled like software.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，指出部署是机器人学的主要挑战；需要严格测试，无法像软件那样规模化。

pathak.en: Pretraining on diverse data (videos, simulation) and post-training on real-world data is the key recipe for robot learning.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，提出在多样化数据（视频、仿真）上预训练，并在真实世界数据上后训练是机器人学习的关键配方。

pathak.en: Video data alone is insufficient; simulation and real-world data are needed to bridge the gap.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，强调仅靠视频数据不足；需要仿真和真实世界数据来弥合差距。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is future but must maintain entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来但需保持熵；特斯拉端到端方法正确；认知核心可以很小。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as OS, prompts as programs; decade of agents, not year; vibe coding raises floor.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 作为操作系统，提示词作为程序；智能体的十年而非一年；Vibe coding 提高下限。

karpathy.en: Pre-training is crappy evolution; RL is terrible; synthetic data collapses; we're summoning ghosts, not building animals.
karpathy.zh: 预训练是糟糕的进化；强化学习很糟糕；合成数据会崩溃；我们在召唤幽灵，而非构建动物。

karpathy.en: I haven't coded since December; agents do all; bottleneck is directing skill; understanding remains human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 自去年 12 月起我不再写代码；智能体做所有事；瓶颈是指挥技能；理解仍是人类瓶颈。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; modern tools make it interpretable, contrary to past beliefs.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，强调端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈，且现代工具使其可解释，颠覆了过去认为端到端不可解释的观点。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors; camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，提出世界模型带来推理和涌现的安全行为；纯视觉可达人类水平，但超越人类安全需雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car via mesh networks, eliminating traffic lights; perfect simulator equals solved self-driving.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，展望 AV 3.0 可能通过网状网络将智能移至车外，消除红绿灯；完美模拟器等同于解决自动驾驶。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem; scaling generalizable AI driver requires massive data, compute, and world models.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，重申自动驾驶本质是 AI 问题；扩展通用 AI 驾驶员需要海量数据、算力和世界模型。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis; infrastructure over algorithms is key.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，强调零样本泛化可覆盖 500+城市；消费级车辆将超越 Robotaxi 规模；基础设施比算法更重要。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Product expansion should follow user workflow, not market size; AI productivity gains are modest for established codebases.
dylanfield.zh: 产品扩展应遵循用户工作流，而非市场规模；AI 对成熟代码库的生产力提升有限。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要；AI 输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on canvas beats prompting for design; design becomes the new code enabling visual-first PRs.
dylanfield.zh: 画布上的直接操作优于提示词；设计成为新代码，实现视觉优先的拉取请求。

dylanfield.en: AI integration is at its very start; human judgment in divergence-convergence loops is key for creativity.
dylanfield.zh: AI 整合才刚刚开始；在发散-收敛循环中，人的判断是创造力的关键。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展（2025）。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: AI 对齐紧迫；迭代部署有助于在现实应用中学习并降低风险（2025）。

pachocki.en: Continual learning via scaling pre-training and RL is core; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现持续学习是核心；思维链监控有助于对齐（2026）。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment focuses on generalization beyond training; models will work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐聚焦于训练分布之外的泛化；模型将自主工作数天（2026）。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is power concentration from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中（2026）。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年以上；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading; real progress requires deep human evaluation, not leaderboard optimization.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性；真正的进步需要深度人工评估，而非排行榜优化。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务来训练模型。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, leading to differentiated AI; eventually every company should train its own models.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室在目标函数上分化，导致 AI 差异化；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI requires human judgment; risks include anchoring, sycophancy, and omission, so safety must be prioritized.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，AI 需要人类判断；风险包括锚定、谄媚和遗漏，因此必须优先考虑安全性。

carlpei.en: Building a brand unites teams on a higher purpose; survival is core, and hardware is easier than software due to distribution challenges.
carlpei.zh: 打造品牌是将团队凝聚在更高使命上；生存是核心，硬件比软件容易，因为软件的发行更难。

carlpei.en: Smartphone future lies in generative UI and proactive agentic software; hardware margins are low, so evolve beyond hardware.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机的未来在于生成式界面和主动的智能体式软件；硬件利润率低，因此必须超越硬件。

carlpei.en: AI models will commoditize and price-war; open-source matches commercial, so focus on applied AI and user context.
carlpei.zh: AI 模型将商品化并陷入价格战；开源与商业模型相当，因此应聚焦于应用型 AI 和用户情境。

carlpei.en: Design is key differentiation in mature categories; AI is an ingredient, not a hype; smartphones won't be replaced by glasses.
carlpei.zh: 在成熟品类中，设计是关键差异化；AI 是成分而非噱头；智能手机不会被眼镜取代。

carlpei.en: Future interaction is intent-based with agents; apps will disappear, and privacy may require local or hybrid compute.
carlpei.zh: 未来交互以意图为基础，由智能体执行；应用将消失，隐私可能要求本地或混合算力。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn user needs.
turley.zh: 模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代，每日发布以了解用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, UI will evolve beyond chat.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来，它就像 MS-DOS，界面将超越聊天。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier models, fast for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型严格，产品开发快速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product, model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、产品和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动、功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我认为 AI 在科学中应聚焦根本性问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年至 2026 年，我持续强调：结合真值检测器，大模型的幻觉可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我指出后训练结合强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我认为可验证领域（如代码）对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 我始终认为，可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应作为增强人类能力的工具；从视频学习和通用智能体是通往 AGI 的有前景路径。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest challenges; Africa can leapfrog legacy issues in AI.
nando.zh: AI 安全与负责任部署是最大挑战；非洲可以在 AI 领域跨越遗留问题。

nando.en: Emphasizes diversity and inclusion in AI community as essential for beneficial technology.
nando.zh: 始终强调 AI 社区的多样性与包容性对构建有益技术至关重要。

nando.en: From focusing on scaling and generalist agents to prioritizing safety and human skills like communication.
nando.zh: 从关注 Scaling 和通用智能体，转向优先考虑安全性和沟通等人际技能。

nando.en: Research requires embracing failure and simplifying problems; human skills are as important as coding.
nando.zh: 研究需要拥抱失败并简化问题；人际技能与编码同等重要。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿提出 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be permissionless and decentralized; control is dangerous. Later, he stresses RL as the core paradigm.
sutton.zh: 2024 至 2025 年间，他主张 AI 应去中心化、无需许可，控制是危险的；随后强调强化学习是智能的核心范式。

sutton.en: LLMs lack world models; true learning is active trial-and-error, not imitation. Scaling LLMs isn't the bitter lesson.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他指出大语言模型没有世界模型，真正的学习是主动试错而非模仿；Scaling 大模型并非苦涩教训。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience; open-ended abstraction is key.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，从运行时经验学习，开放式抽象是关键。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is learning from experience; temporal difference learning is his best work. Representation learning remains unsolved.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他重申强化学习是从经验中学习，时序差分学习是其最佳成果；表征学习仍是未解难题。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs are like operating systems.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，认为具身对 AI 落地和减少幻觉至关重要，LLM 像操作系统。

jimfan.en: Data bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling.
jimfan.zh: 2023 至 2026 年，强调机器人数据瓶颈，合成数据与仿真世界模型是扩展的关键。

jimfan.en: Physical Turing test (robot cleaning a messy house) is the grand challenge for embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，提出物理图灵测试（机器人整理乱屋）是具身 AI 的终极挑战。

jimfan.en: System two reasoning progresses, but system one low-level control remains hardest in embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，指出系统二推理进展顺利，但系统一低级控制仍是具身 AI 最难部分。

jimfan.en: Robots will exceed iPhones by 2040; GPT-3 moment for robotics in ~5 years, home use later.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，预测 2040 年机器人数量超 iPhone，机器人 GPT-3 时刻约 5 年内到来，家用更晚。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can match larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小的模型也能媲美较大的模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data is insufficient; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety and alignment.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我始终强调仅靠互联网数据的预训练不够，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）等后训练对安全与对齐至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我指出数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning can be applied during pre-training to improve reasoning, though computationally expensive.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出在预训练阶段引入强化学习可提升推理能力，尽管计算成本高昂。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; debiasing the internet is impossible.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张多元对齐以尊重人类价值观的多样性；同时认为对互联网去偏不可行。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文被低估，上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能显著提升智能。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis, enabling expert-level skills and agentic reliability.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的扩展轴，能实现专家级技能和智能体可靠性。

sholto.en: Pre-training plus RL is likely sufficient for AGI; no new architecture needed, but inference compute will bottleneck by 2028.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练加强化学习足以实现 AGI，无需新架构，但推理算力将在 2028 年成为瓶颈。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator for AI progress; agents will automate white-collar jobs by 2027-2028.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我持续认为编码是 AI 进步的领先指标，智能体将在 2027-2028 年自动化白领工作。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and compute matter more; world models are not critical path to AGI.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我指出能力过剩使编排和算力更重要，世界模型并非 AGI 关键路径。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over innovation.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年：设计师应会编程以建立共情并加速交付；优先追求速度和熟悉感，而非创新。

henrymodisett.en: Brand is a strategic weapon for recruiting and differentiation; invest early to attract talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 至 2026 年：品牌是招聘和差异化的战略武器；早期投入以吸引人才。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; give designers autonomy to grow and decide.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年：招聘多元原型而非克隆；赋予设计师自主权以成长和决策。

henrymodisett.en: Avoid structured design crits; prefer organic feedback to maintain velocity and decisiveness.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年：避免结构化设计评审；偏好有机反馈以保持速度和决断力。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs; gut decisions often beat data-driven ones in fast-growing startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 始终：不惜一切代价追求速度；在快速成长的初创公司，直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck; AI is a creative partner; code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴；代码是唯一事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt, paid iteratively; rapid scrappy experimentation maximizes learning.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务，需迭代偿还；快速粗糙的实验能最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution with AI are most valuable; small teams outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 掌握端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should show craft and intentionality, not process; side projects can outweigh experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应展示工艺与意图，而非过程；副项目可胜过传统经验。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; ignoring it is like ignoring early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成常态；忽视它如同早期忽视互联网。

brettaylor.en: AI shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models remain for hyperscalers; startups target applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型仍由超大规模企业主导；初创企业聚焦应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: Future programming languages prioritize verifiability for AI generation; coding agents need root-cause fixes.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：未来编程语言优先考虑 AI 生成的可验证性；编码智能体需根本原因修复。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience become as vital as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value with business results.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：客户体验 AI 智能体变得与网站同等重要；基于结果的定价使价值与业务成果对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software agents turn developers into operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：推理成本大幅下降，催生新用例；软件智能体使开发者变为操作者。

brettaylor.en: Incumbents face business model challenges; generalists leveraging AI outperform narrow specialists.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：现有企业面临商业模式挑战；利用 AI 的通才胜过狭隘专才。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored. Focus on skill building, not capability work.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚待开发。应注重技能培养，而非能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督和可解释性。对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone insufficient. Third-party oversight and regulation needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化退化，仅靠后训练不足。需要第三方监督和监管。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，认为缩放定律可预测进展，测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展成为下一主要驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are often better.
truell.zh: 2024 年，认为自然语言不会成为主要编程方式，示例和直接操作往往更优。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost; every magic moment involves them.
truell.zh: 2024 至 25 年，强调定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其在速度和成本上；每个神奇时刻都涉及它们。

truell.en: Future programming moves from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 2025 年，认为未来编程从代码转向更高层次的意图规范，人类仍处于主导地位。

truell.en: AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and will take decades to unfold.
truell.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 变革将比互联网更具影响力，并需数十年才能充分展开。

abbeel.en: Self-play and imitation learning are powerful for robotics; deep RL benefits from piecewise linear control, not magic.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年：自我对弈和模仿学习对机器人学很有效；深度强化学习的成功部分源于分段线性控制，而非魔法。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus RL boosts sample efficiency; hard-coding priors can hurt; language models transfer to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年：无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升样本效率；硬编码先验知识可能有害；语言模型可迁移到非语言任务。

shazeer.en: Scaling models with more compute and data leads to smarter AI; next-token prediction is an AI-complete problem.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为通过更多算力和数据扩展模型能带来更智能的 AI，而下一个词预测是 AI 完备问题。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models should learn by acting in the world.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他强调推理时算力扩展是近期重大机遇，并主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非仅被动观察数据。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他认为测试时算力扩展推动进步但不足以实现 AGI，智能体式能力对 AGI 至关重要。

shazeer.en: Open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models; coding is underhyped and enables self-acceleration.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他指出开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距，并认为编码被低估，它能实现 AI 的自我加速。

shazeer.en: AI safety requires engineering safeguards and human oversight; understanding model capabilities is essential.
shazeer.zh: 始终，他坚持 AI 安全需要工程防护和人类监督，并强调理解模型能力的重要性。
